selection_rationale: A balanced 8-ship gun line: four armored cruisers provide spinal coilers and turret firepower, while four frigates thicken point defense and add screening coilguns. The 1.5g core can dictate range against slow capitals and still mass enough PD to blunt torpedo salvos.
formation_rationale: Cruisers are placed 90 km forward as the vanguard so they absorb the first exchange and present a broad spinal-gun wall. Frigates sit 90 km behind, interleaved into the cruiser lateral gaps, keeping fragile torpedo hulls out of early gun range while every frigate remains within ~95 km of at least one cruiser. Lateral spacing of 80 km between cruisers and 60 km between frigates, with alternating +/-20 km vertical offsets, keeps PD bubbles overlapping across the whole formation without putting all ships in a single plane.
